protocol.name: Clip4Retrofit-style per-class one-vs-rest ROC-AUC
protocol.score: raw per-class confidence; cosine similarity for paper reproduction
protocol.auroc: sklearn roc_curve followed by trapezoidal sklearn auc
protocol.macro_auroc: unweighted arithmetic mean of per-class AUROCs
protocol.fpr_at_target_tpr: first attainable ROC point with TPR >= target_tpr
protocol.macro_fpr_at_target_tpr: unweighted arithmetic mean of per-class FPR@targetTPR
